title.en: The missing switch inside cloud research
title.zh: 云端研究缺失的那道交换关口

summary.en: Jeffery Lim built an FPGA research platform that recreates key cloud-networking functions. MIT’s November 2 report and the authors’ 2026 manuscript describe a working prototype; broader release and production deployment remain separate milestones.
summary.zh: Jeffery Lim构建了可重现云端网络关键功能的FPGA研究平台。MIT11月2日报道及作者2026年稿件记载了工作原型；广泛开源发布与生产部署仍属另一步。

title.en: The mineral bottleneck beyond the mine
title.zh: 矿井之外，还有一道矿物瓶颈

summary.en: Elsa Olivetti’s November 3 MIT interview explains why extraction, separation, refining and manufacturing must work together. Gallium’s byproduct dependence and dated USGS production figures expose the difference between possessing ore and securing usable material.
summary.zh: Elsa Olivetti在MIT11月3日访谈中解释，开采、分离、精炼与制造须环环相接。镓的副产品来源及注明年代的USGS数据，揭示有矿与有可用材料之间的距离。
